name: Put A Sock In It!
source:
PUT A SOCK IN IT! is an outrageously silly choose-your-own-adventure game featuring Animated Sock Action, about 90 Endings and 30 Life Lessons for you to help the characters learn. 

What would you do if you were trapped someplace all alone? Put A Sock In It! dares ask the question: How far would you go in the name of entertaining yourself? 

Serena locked herself in the stairwell with all her coworkers gone for the weekend. With no way of contacting the outside world and no hint of rescue in sight, Serena will discover that maybe, just maybe, her best friend is actually herself. And these sock puppets she just made...
translation:
把袜子放进去！是一款极其愚蠢的选择你自己的冒险游戏，以动画袜子动作为特色，大约有90个结局和30个人生课程，可以帮助角色学习。

如果你独自一人被困在某个地方，你会怎么做？把袜子放进去！敢于问这样一个问题：为了娱乐自己，你会走多远？

瑟琳娜把自己锁在楼梯间里，而她所有的同事都去度周末了。由于无法与外界联系，也看不到救援的迹象，瑟琳娜会发现也许，只是也许，她最好的朋友实际上是她自己。还有她刚刚制作的这些袜子木偶……
